import assert from "node:assert/strict"
import { mkdtemp, writeFile, mkdir, rm } from "node:fs/promises"
import { tmpdir } from "node:os"
import { join, dirname } from "node:path"
import { createRuntimeFetchHandler } from "../repo/packages/cli/dist/runtime-exports.js"

async function makeFixture(routeSource: string) {
  const appRoot = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "b4-run-wait-"))
  await mkdir(join(appRoot, "src/app/noop"), { recursive: true })
  await writeFile(join(appRoot, "b4.config.ts"), "export default {}\n")
  await writeFile(join(appRoot, "package.json"), '{ "name": "fixture", "type": "module" }\n')
  await writeFile(join(appRoot, "src/app/noop/index.ts"), routeSource)
  return appRoot
}

async function jsonPost(handler: any, path: string, body: unknown) {
  const req = new Request(`http://localhost${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
  })
  return handler.fetch(req)
}

test("A1: POST /threads/:id/runs/wait returns a 200 response with content-type application/json and an empty body when the route returns undefined", async () => {
  const appRoot = await makeFixture("export const workflow = async () => undefined\n")
  try {
    const handler = await createRuntimeFetchHandler({ appRoot })
    try {
      const res = await jsonPost(handler, "/threads/t-undef/runs/wait", { input: {}, route: "/noop#workflow" })
      assert.equal(res.status, 200)
      const ct = res.headers.get("content-type") ?? ""
      assert.match(ct, /application\/json/)
      const text = await res.text()
      assert.equal(text, "")
    } finally {
      await handler.close()
    }
  } finally {
    await rm(appRoot, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

test("A2: POST /threads/:id/runs/wait returns 200 and a JSON body for a route that returns an object (e.g. { ok: true })", async () => {
  const appRoot = await makeFixture("export const workflow = async () => ({ ok: true })\n")
  try {
    const handler = await createRuntimeFetchHandler({ appRoot })
    try {
      const res = await jsonPost(handler, "/threads/t-ok/runs/wait", { input: {}, route: "/noop#workflow" })
      assert.equal(res.status, 200)
      const ct = res.headers.get("content-type") ?? ""
      assert.match(ct, /application\/json/)
      const body = await res.json()
      assert.deepEqual(body, { ok: true })
    } finally {
      await handler.close()
    }
  } finally {
    await rm(appRoot, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})

test("A3: When a route execution throws, POST /threads/:id/runs/wait returns 500 with a JSON body whose error.kind is \"execution_error\".", async () => {
  const appRoot = await makeFixture("export const workflow = async () => { throw new Error('boom') }\n")
  try {
    const handler = await createRuntimeFetchHandler({ appRoot })
    try {
      const res = await jsonPost(handler, "/threads/t-boom/runs/wait", { input: {}, route: "/noop#workflow" })
      assert.equal(res.status, 500)
      const ct = res.headers.get("content-type") ?? ""
      assert.match(ct, /application\/json/)
      const body = await res.json()
      assert.equal(body?.error?.kind, "execution_error")
    } finally {
      await handler.close()
    }
  } finally {
    await rm(appRoot, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
})
